pass_condition: The packet's headline acceptance (v1 -> v2 migration on a copy of the v1 DB) runs wherever the suite runs.

evidence.command: env -u PYTEST_ADDOPTS PYTHONPATH=<tree> python -B -m pytest -p no:cacheprovider tests/store/

findings.statement: Both v1-migration acceptance tests are gated on a machine-specific absolute path and skip silently anywhere else, leaving a green suite with the packet's headline claim unexecuted.
findings.quoted_line: @pytest.mark.skipif(not V1_BASELINE.exists(), reason="v1 baseline fixture not present in this environment")
findings.failure_scenario: Repointing V1_BASELINE at a nonexistent path turns the suite into '27 passed, 2 skipped' -- still green, with the legacy-preservation and no-op guards both unrun. In CI, or on any other machine, that is the default state.

observations: Fix: build a minimal v1-shaped repositories table inside the test (or commit a tiny fixture DB) so the path always runs, keeping the real 1,000-row DB as an extra opt-in case.

not_checked.statement: W4-3's persona re-projection SQL and W4-4's endpoints are not in this packet; only the reader helpers they build on were checked.
